headline: Athi Water Works Development Agency Halts Supply To Kiambu Providers
seoTitle: Athi Water Works Development Agency Halts Kiambu Water
metaDescription: The Athi Water Works Development Agency has suspended bulk water supply to six water providers in Kiambu County after a recent High Court ruling.
aiSummaryBullets: Athi Water Works Development Agency stopped providing bulk water to six companies in Kiambu County.
The suspension follows a High Court order issued on November 18, 2026, which restricted the agency's direct supply operations.
Approximately 72 million liters of daily water supply are affected by the implementation of the court mandate.
aiContextParagraph: The Athi Water Works Development Agency (AWWDA) announced the suspension of bulk water deliveries to six water service providers operating within Kiambu County. This decision stems from a legal directive issued by the High Court in Kiambu on November 18, 2026. The court order specifically bars the state-run agency from engaging in the direct supply of water to these local utility companies. According to the agency, this cessation impacts a daily volume of 72 million liters of water previously distributed to the region. The move highlights an ongoing regulatory or legal dispute concerning water distribution management between the national development agency and local service providers. As of now, the utility companies affected by the interruption are navigating the implications of this shift in supply chain operations as established by the court's interim ruling.
whyItIsViral: The development is currently being tracked by two independent media outlets with a moderate rate of reporting velocity.
